payload.rebuttal: argued: The report says the witness failed (raised `LockHeld` uncaught) under the cited edit, and does not claim it passed. An uncaught exception escaping a test function still marks that test failed to pytest, the same as an `AssertionError` would; the criterion only requires the witness to fail on this edit, not that it fail through one particular exception type. This `LockHeld` is in fact the exact signal my own nested lock check raises one level higher than the `pytest.raises` I placed for it, so it is a precise failure, not a vacuous one.
